family.description: This domain contains armadillo-like repeats [[cite:PUB00057475]]. Proteins containing this domain interact with numerous other proteins, through these interactions they are involved in a wide variety of processes including carcinogenesis [[cite:PUB00057476]], control of cellular ageing and survival [[cite:PUB00057475]], regulation of circadian rhythm [[cite:PUB00057477]] and lysosomal sorting of G protein-coupled receptors [[cite:PUB00057478]].
family.name: Armadillo-like
